feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: 5 simple ways to relieve the aches and pains of sitting at a desk all day
entry.summary: Sitting at a desk all day hurts. And it isn't good for us. Strategies to make it a little more comfortable, from eye muscle exercises to alleviate eye strain to a back pain-fighting body movement.

entry.title: Farm country has beef with Trump as midterms approach
entry.summary: President Trump's attempts to bring beef prices down has potentially backfired politically in several key states.

entry.title: Trump merchandise stores are closing: 'He has peaked'
entry.summary: At least four Trump merchandise stores have closed this year. Store owners say with Trump in his final term, there isn't as much to fire up his consumer fan base and sales have softened.

entry.title: A GOP congressman voted to cut Medicaid. It covers 62% of his district. Can he win?
entry.summary: Republican U.S. Rep. David Valadao is fighting for reelection in central California. 6 in 10 residents of his district are covered by Medicaid, which he voted to cut last year.

entry.title: Trump's redistricting gave Republicans a head start, now it goes to the voters
entry.summary: President Trump, seeking to reshape the voting map, prompted a rare wave of mid-decade redistricting that gave Republicans a boost for holding the House. But the voters will determine if it works.

entry.title: How long does it take to save up for a starter home? Twice as long as it did in 2019
entry.summary: A new analysis finds that the average renter household now needs 16 years to save for a down payment and closing costs. Rising rents and other costs have consumed a growing share of household budgets.

entry.title: See how Big Tech is transforming Spain's landscape
entry.summary: A drought-stricken region of northeast Spain has become a focus for American companies searching for locations to place their data centers.

entry.title: Can a dream help you solve a problem? Here's how to try tonight
entry.summary: What can you learn from dreams and how can you remember them and steer them to the topics you wish to dream about. Allison Aubrey and A Martinez discuss the resurgance in dream research and how dreams are a tool for self-discovery.

entry.title: High health costs squeeze workers, even if you have good insurance through a job
entry.summary: About 157 million Americans get their health insurance through work. A survey of employers shows a moderate price uptick this year, but workers still say health costs are a top concern.

entry.title: He left Chile on foot to England 28 years ago. He's almost finally home
entry.summary: British Adventurer Karl Bushby left Chile with the goal of walking an unbroken path back to his childhood home in England. Now, 28 years later, his Goliath Expedition is coming to a close.
